violated_contract: Every gate that assumes a real billing, subscription, or whole-account migration plane is running must carry the same PROVIDER_MODE=='offline' self-hosted bypass as its sibling gates, not just the first one that got it.
canonical_prevention: When adding a PROVIDER_MODE=='offline' bypass to one gate in a family (billing, migration, cutover), audit sibling gates making the same real-plane assumption in the same request/response family and add the bypass to all of them in the same change.
